Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. You can’t ignore the requirements specified for DNA digivolution when using this card's [Main] effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to DNA digivolve using 1 of my Digimon that isn't specified for DNA digivolution and a card in the hand?

Effect: While your opponent has a level 6 or higher Digimon, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] 1 of your level 6 Digimon and 1 card in the hand may DNA digivolve into a level 7 Digimon card in the hand.
Security Effect: [Security] Return 1 level 6 or higher Digimon card from your trash to the hand. Then, add this card to the hand.
